stories.title: Week 1 AP poll reaction: What's next for each Top 25 team
stories.summary: We examine what happened along with what lies ahead.

stories.title: SEC schedules vote about whether to expel LSU
stories.summary: The SEC has filed an amended complaint against LSU regarding its potential plans to add ex-NFL players and scheduled a vote on whether to expel the Tigers.

stories.title: Mahomes expected to start MNF opener, but Chiefs face issues at left tackle
stories.summary: Patrick Mahomes is expected to start the Chiefs' season opener Monday against the Broncos.

stories.title: Dabo accepts criticism for loss, pushes back on roster building
stories.summary: Dabo Swinney says the criticism he is taking following Clemson's embarrassing 51-10 season-opening loss to No. 11 LSU on Saturday is deserved.

stories.title: Cowboys have 'serious' financial room for a trade, Jerry Jones says
stories.summary: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones told 105.3 The Fan on Tuesday that the team has "serious room financially" to make a trade after restructuring several veteran contracts last week.
